summary: Solid test suite covering all major requirements (glob matching, multi-label assignment, priority/exclusive conflict resolution, error handling, workflow structure). Strong edge case coverage for core functionality (empty inputs, missing fields, deduplication, priority conflicts). Well-organized with clear fixtures and TDD methodology documented. Minor gaps: YAML validation uses regex patterns rather than full parsing; some exotic glob combinations (e.g., multiple exclusive rules at same priority) untested; temp directory cleanup in InvokeLabelAssigner.Tests could be more explicit; Run-ActTests.ps1 integration harness itself lacks unit coverage though tested implicitly. Would reliably catch regressions in main workflows but could miss some boundary conditions.
